data.long_meaning: Ruddy means having a red or ruddy complexion, often due to good health and heartiness. It is an old English name derived from the Old Norse word 'Rudh' meaning red. The name Ruddie carries the meaning “Red” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ruddie usually hope their child will grow to embody red and live with faith, good character and purpose.
